digest.component_or_area: Store event append seam / secret screening
propositions: Event bodies containing live credentials (Anthropic keys, GitHub PATs, Gemini, Jira, OpenAI, PyPI tokens) are accepted and persisted by append_event with no write-time content screening, allowing secrets to reach the shared store and trigger GitHub push protection, wedging the tickets branch for all concurrent agents

The store's write path has multiple entry points (append_event, reconciler inbound translate, txn/delete cores) and a screen at append_event alone leaves the reconciler's Jira-sourced comment/edit bodies unprotected

A refused write on secret detection must name the matched family and field location, must not echo the secret value through any output or log channel, and must include a CLI-only --allow-secret-pattern override that records the reason and bypassed families on the forced event for auditability

Benign look-alike text (truncated placeholders like 'sk-ant-api03-...', regex literals, prose enumerating PEM banners) must pass the screen without refusal to make it safe for operators to leave enabled by default
The reconciler's inbound translate currently routes around append_event by calling finalize_event's halves directly, bypassing any write-time screening in append_event
The screen must use fixed-width pattern windows rather than greedy quantifiers so that same-class padding appended after a real key cannot dilute entropy below the detection floor
